app.footerNote: Your data stays on your Mac.

today.title: Your newspaper is ready.
today.lead: Yesterday's important news, organized so you can read it calmly today.
today.frontHint: Front page · click to read all {{count}} pages

timeline.builtDetail: Summaries and front page in the {{style}} style

today.nextText: You don't need to keep the app open. It collects, organizes and prints on its own.
today.emptyLead: As soon as the news is collected, the front page shows up here.
today.emptyText: The next edition comes out on its own {{when}} at {{time}}. If you like, generate one now with the latest news.
today.emptyNoSources: Pick at least one source so Morning Paper has something to read.
today.oldLead: Today's edition isn't out yet. Meanwhile, here's the most recent one.
today.pausedTitle: The {{when}} edition is skipped. Then it goes back to normal.
today.aiSkipped: The AI assistant didn't respond; the edition used the sources' own summaries.

edition.title: Read your edition.
edition.lead: Leaf through it like a real newspaper. Use the ← → keys to turn the page.

review.title: Review before printing.
review.lead: If something doesn't seem important to you, take it out. You can bring it back whenever you want.
review.headlineLocked: The headline can't be removed. Pick another one first.

toast.removed: Story taken out of the edition.
toast.headline: New front-page headline.

print.title: Print your newspaper.
print.lead: Today's edition is ready in black and white, on A4 paper, to save ink.

msg.offline: {{printer}} is off. Turn the printer on and try again, or
msg.pdf: PDF ready: choose “Save as PDF” in the dialog. Suggested name: morning-paper-{{n}}.pdf
msg.failed: The print dialog didn't open. Try again.

toast.pdfHint: In the dialog, open the PDF menu and choose “Save as PDF”.
toast.pdfSaved: PDF saved to Documents › Morning Paper › {{file}}

printer.pdfMeta: No printer — choose where to save in the dialog

sources.title: Your sources
sources.lead: Pick only the places you trust. Morning Paper reads everything overnight and merges repeated stories.
sources.caption: News sources

empty.title: Your first newspaper
empty.text: Pick a few sources and your first edition shows up here early tomorrow.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.text: News from {{name}} will no longer appear in upcoming editions. You can add it again whenever you want.

add.title: Add source
add.name: Name
add.urlHint: It can be the feed address (RSS/Atom) or the website's page.

err.urlInvalid: The address must start with https:// — check that you copied the whole link.
err.notFeed: I couldn't find a news feed at that address.

add.nameHint: Optional: if left blank, we use the feed's own name.

toast.paused: {{name}} paused. It won't appear in upcoming editions.
toast.added_one: {{name}} added: {{count}} story in the feed right now.
toast.added_other: {{name}} added: {{count}} stories in the feed right now.

local.title: News from your city
local.text: Type the city where you live and Morning Paper looks up what local papers and sites published about it.
local.hint: You can add the state or country to avoid cities with the same name.
local.name: News from {{city}}
local.notFound: I couldn't find recent news about that city. Check the name and try again.

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.lead: Set it up once. Then just wake up and read. Everything is saved automatically.

printer.title: Default printer
printer.note: Each morning's edition goes straight to it.
printer.ask: Ask which printer to use every time

topics.title: What you want to read
topics.note: When you move one topic, the others adjust to add up to 100%.

style.title: Newspaper style
style.note: The front page on Today changes right away. Printing stays black and white.

background.title: In the background
background.note: Morning Paper doesn't need to stay open. It prepares and prints the edition on its own.
background.loginNote: Starts quietly, without opening the window
background.keep: Keep running when the window is closed
background.keepNote: Closing the window doesn't stop tomorrow's edition
background.wake: Wake the Mac to generate the edition
background.wakeNote: If it's asleep, it wakes up for a few minutes
background.menubarNote: Shortcut to print, generate or pause without opening the app
background.dock: Hide from the Dock while the window is open too
background.dockNote: When you close the window, the app already leaves the Dock and stays in the menu bar
background.dockDisabled: Available when the menu bar shortcut is on

ai.title: Summarizing assistant
ai.note1: AI is optional. It merges the same story from several sources, writes short summaries and suggests the headline. Without AI, the newspaper uses each source's own summary and sorts by time and priority.
ai.note2: Morning Paper doesn't ask for an API key: it uses a command-line assistant already installed and signed in on your Mac.

notes.ollama: Runs on your Mac, sends no data
notes.opencode: Uses the provider configured in it

ai.notFound: Not found on this Mac. Install it and click Search again.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.appLangNote: Follows the macOS language ({{lang}}). To change it, go to System Settings › General › Language & Region.

toast.noAi: No AI: the newspaper will use each source's summary.
toast.ai: The next edition will be summarized by {{name}}.
toast.noPrinters: No new printers found on the network.
toast.wake: Your Mac will wake 5 minutes before {{time}}.
toast.wakeFailed: Wake wasn't turned on (the administrator password is required).

toast.extra: An extra edition is ready to review.
toast.paused: The {{when}} edition won't come out. Then it goes back to normal.

generate.aiFailed: The AI didn't respond ({{error}}). I used the sources' summaries.
generate.hint: You can keep using the app; the front page shows up here when it's done.

step.grouping: Merging repeated stories and picking the lineup…

error.noSources: No active sources. Add or resume a source in Sources.
error.noNews: No news from the last 36 hours in your sources.
error.save: Couldn't save the edition to disk.

delivery.title: Edition #{{n}} is ready
delivery.ready: Your newspaper is ready to read.
delivery.failed: The edition is out, but delivery failed: {{error}}

welcome.title: Your newspaper, printed every morning.
welcome.lead: Morning Paper reads the sources you trust, merges repeated stories and delivers a calm black-and-white edition before you wake up.
welcome.collectDetail: Any site with RSS: newspapers, blogs, magazines.
welcome.summarize: Summarizes with the AI you already use
welcome.summarizeDetail: Claude, Codex, Gemini, Ollama… or no AI.
welcome.print: Prints on its own on A4
welcome.printDetail: Or saves a PDF. Takes under 2 minutes to set up.

sources.title: Where does the news come from?
sources.lead: Check the outlets you trust. You can change them later in Sources.
sources.urlHint: Paste a website or RSS feed address. We check it right away.
sources.notFeed: I couldn't find a news feed at that address.

edition.title: When and how much to read?
edition.lead: Choose the time, the length and the weight of each topic.

printer.title: Where to print?
printer.lead: The morning edition goes straight to this printer. Without a printer, it's saved as a PDF.

assistant.title: Who writes the summaries?
assistant.lead: Optional. We use an AI assistant already installed on your Mac; without AI, the paper uses the sources' text.

background.title: Let it work on its own.
background.lead: So the edition comes out on time, the app runs quietly in the menu bar.

finish.title: Your newspaper is set up.
finish.lead: From tomorrow, the edition comes out at {{time}}. Want to see the first one now?
finish.note: The first edition uses news from the last 36 hours.

errorBoundary.title: This screen didn't open.
errorBoundary.text: Your editions and preferences are still saved. Reload the app or go to another screen from the sidebar.
